observation: Front shows the flat sagittal bed, four millimetre fan half, and attached hemispherical ball and half-neck. Top shows five blunt lobes with a two millimetre flat on the lowest leading lobe, clear open relief below the lobes, and a broad stepped root collar without the old feathered root. Iso confirms continuous fan, neck, collar and half-ball with no floating geometry. Tiny leading relief edge is consistent with the reported 0.17 percent edge taper. These views do not establish joint motion or physical strength.
